image_description: A high-angle, flat-lay photograph showing a scattered collection of approximately 12-15 audio cassette tapes resting on a textured, golden-brown straw or hay background. The cassettes vary in condition and style: some are standard black plastic cases with paper J-cards (labels), one is a transparent case revealing green magnetic tape, another is a clear case with brown tape, and several appear to be vintage or damaged with peeling labels. The lighting is diffuse, casting soft shadows.
